## What's Changed

- Adds the versioned `/api/v1/player/home` endpoint for Tater Tube Player.
- Aggregates Continue Watching, Recently Added, libraries, capabilities, and lightweight Tube TV now/next data in one authenticated response.
- Adds authenticated local poster artwork discovery through `/api/v1/player/artwork/local`.
- Supports media-adjacent `poster`, `folder`, `cover`, and title-matched JPG, PNG, and WebP images.
- Keeps every existing `/api/tater/*` player route and response compatible with existing Tater Tube clients.
- Adds regression coverage for player authentication, home aggregation, local-artwork path safety, and Tube TV progress.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

Tater Tube Player requires this release (or newer) for its live paired home screen.
Existing Tater Tube players continue using their current endpoints unchanged.
